name: Armd Bde Advance to Contact
note: An Armd Bde leading an Armd Div's advance to contact (OoW Vol II s4 paras 1-5 pp 9-11, Fig 2 p 9). Plan metres from the SP (the click: the Van Gd's head crosses it first), y back from the direction of advance (the aim). Covering troops (the Recce Regt / LAT Bn as mobile troops) 4-8 km ahead (6 km), flank guards about 6 km out on each side, the Advance Guard an Armr Regt group: its Van Gd (the leading Sqn group, FOO, Regt Tac) about 3500 m deep, then the Main Gd about 3000 m; the Main Body (the Bde less, Bde Tac, the follow-up Bde behind) about 8 km back (15-20 km for the Armd Div). The Fig 2 figures are read off a highlighted scan: uncertain (PlanDoctrine.advance). With the terrain the axis is read for the going for tracks and the flank guards' ground.
